title: Total Protein Extraction from Adipose Tissue and Cells
author: Caroline Green
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wurfev6

steps.title: Pre-cool Equipment
steps.instruction: Pre-cool the buffer A, centrifuge column, and receiver tube sleeve on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Adipose Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the adipose tissue and initial buffer addition.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 50-80 mg of fresh or frozen adipose tissue.
Place tissue on several layers of paper towels and squeeze with thumb and forefinger to remove a portion of the oil.
Transfer tissue into the supplied 1.5 ml centrifuge tube using tweezers.
Add 100 mg of protein extract powder to the sample.
Add 50 ul of buffer A.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue sample using a grinding rod.

substeps.instruction: Twist the sample with a grinding rod for 1-2 minutes.
Add 200-300 ul Buffer A (if initial tissue amount was small, 20-40 mg, use 100-150 ul instead).
Continue grinding for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Extract Protein
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and transfer the sample to the column.

substeps.instruction: Cap the lid and centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant to a centrifuge column placed in the receiver tube.

steps.title: Incubate and Recover Protein
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample and perform final centrifugation to obtain protein.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at -20 °C for 15-20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 2,000 rpm for 1-2 minutes.
Discard the centrifuge tube to obtain the total protein.

steps.title: Prepare Protein for Downstream Applications
steps.instruction: Depending on the intended application, resuspend or dilute the extracted protein.

substeps.instruction: For denatured protein solution (SDS-PAGE, Western): Add 1/10 buffer B.
For non-denaturing protein solution (IP, ELISA): Add 1/10 buffer C.
For 2D analysis: Dissolve in 2X 2D gel sample buffer.
Alternatively, use the protein directly in ELISA for water-soluble proteins.

steps.title: Prepare Fat Cell Sample
steps.instruction: Process fat cells for protein extraction.

substeps.instruction: Collect 50-100 million fat cells by low speed centrifugation.
Resuspend cells by adding 1 ml of pre-cooled PBS (containing phosphatase or protease inhibitor) to a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 100 mg protein extract powder.

steps.title: Homogenize Fat Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and grind the fat cell sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 3 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Twist with a lapping rod for 1-2 minutes to homogenize cells.
Add 200-300 ul Buffer A and continue grinding for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant to the pre-cooled centrifuge column receiver tube cannula.
